prompt:
BOTH heads strict RIGHT-FACING PROFILE. Preserve reference head size and native body scale. This is a walking PASSING phase: left drawing has one supporting leg almost straight directly under pelvis and the OTHER knee raised in FRONT, with ankle tucked underneath that raised knee. Right drawing extends that raised leg slightly forward into the next contact, compact short stride. Not a back heel curl, not facing the viewer. Keep full shoes inside image margins. RIGHT head center MUST be x820 instead of x950; rightmost shoe stops before x1150. Both full bodies and every toe inside canvas. Keep individual body scale unchanged from reference.
Use case: identity-preserve. Production animation pose pair.
Exactly TWO separate full-body animation drawings side by side in one portrait image, aspect 1205:1305. Two equal vertical cells. LEFT drawing body center at x=260, RIGHT drawing body center at x=820. Shift BOTH figures toward the LEFT so their forward toes have space to the RIGHT. Keep an empty green gap. Keep all hair, hands, clothing and accessories inside each cell, with an empty green gap between them. Full native detail, about 1000 pixels figure height, no thumbnail sheet. Neutral standing boots at y=1200, top of hair around y=180. Preserve this scale for EVERY pose; crouching is shorter, jumping is displaced upward, never zoom a pose to fill its cell. Flat pure chroma green RGB(0,255,0), no floor, cast shadow, gradient, green reflection, checkerboard, writing, symbols, UI, bubbles, watermarks or extra figures. Opaque character with crisp fine cel-shaded outlines, polished eyes, accurate hands, coherent hair locks and fabric folds. Left and right images are two successive ANIMATION DRAWINGS of the SAME identity and outfit, not different costume designs.
ORIGINAL Assistant-004 slender anime version, exactly about 5 heads tall, adult elegant proportions, head about 20 percent of total standing height. Reference bottom row only. Chestnut long layered hair, asymmetric curved fringe, small plain teal barrette on her left, narrow blue-violet eyes, restrained skeptical scientist expression. Preserve face, hair shape, boot style and proportions across drawings.
OUTFIT IN BOTH CELLS: Short charcoal jacket with gray cuffs, pale-gray collared shirt, short burgundy tie, black shorts, opaque dark tights and black ankle boots with small teal trim.
LEFT CELL: RIGHT profile WALK PASSING pose: left support leg STRAIGHT VERTICALLY directly under hips. Right thigh raised FORWARD to the RIGHT, right knee ahead of the body, right shin vertical and right boot dangling UNDER that forward knee. Both arms nearly vertical passing the hips. NOT a wide stride, NOT a heel curled behind. Support foot planted. Draw this precise new leg pose, not reference legs.
RIGHT CELL: RIGHT profile WALK UP pose: left support ankle on toe directly under hips, right knee and right boot AHEAD of the torso to the RIGHT, right shin starts extending toward next contact, boot still airborne. Right arm swings slightly backward, left arm forward. Torso rises slightly, hair and hem trail left. NO rear heel curl, no wide grounded stride.
BOTH heads strictly RIGHT-facing SIDE PROFILE: one visible eye, nose points horizontally RIGHT. Never rotate face toward viewer; keep reference profile head and torso angle identical. Draw the specified changing limbs only.
Only these two poses. Do not reuse identical neutral standing art for active poses. Precise same head size, leg length, eye shape and hair silhouette. Never add failure X marks, wave lines or a visible keyboard.
